title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light — Episode5 Commonalities

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Event Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do we have in common?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like it if you could find something you have deeply in common with Thorpe. Even just one will suffice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Will he get better if he finds one?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Remember when we had Tsukasa play the Black Knight a good while back?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Black Knight...? Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Argh!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “That flash of light... What was it?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “You remember now, don't you, Black Knight? You used to wield your sword to protect people, to keep peace.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “So those shinies were his memories coming back? It looked so pretty!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You're right... I'd forgotten what was really important to me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I shall vow to only ever brandish my sword in the name of peace as I had in the past!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “The Black Knight was once again back on the righteous path and peace returned to the world.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember!
That show we did before Halloween!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. I definitely had trouble getting into character that time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You did?
I didn't know that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hadn't played many bad guys before until that point, so I wasn't sure about how I was supposed to act...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui suggested that the Black Knight and I were similar because we both have strong wills and steadfast principles that keep us from budging.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Playing that role became much easier after I started taking that into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And this search for commonalities is a similar exercise.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you seem to prefer to learn by doing or through instinct as opposed to logically analyzing a character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe finding something in common with your character will open quite a few doors for you in terms of imagining how to play him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And just one will suffice.
One thing you think you have in common with this character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And you'll be exempt from practicing lines until you do. Rather, please refrain from doing so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
No practicing lines?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So we have to practice without him?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But he's in almost every scene.
That means we won't be able to practice much, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can ask KAITO and the others about filling in as Thorpe. I'm sure they'll be willing to help once we explain our situation to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I personally don't want us going into a show knowing that our lead has yet to figure out their character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In addition, practicing while in this state will likely start affecting everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I want you to find some commonalities with your character, Tsukasa, and unravel this enigma. Can you do that for us...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
As a future star, I vow to overcome this obstacle! I guarantee that you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's our star for you. Always giving it 12,000%. We'll be looking forward to seeing some good results...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I believe in you, Tsukasa!
You can do it! I know you can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I agree...
I'm sure you'll figure out something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will... After all, it's a star's duty to rise to any occasion!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll leave you to it for now.
In the meantime, we'll be asking KAITO to see if we can practice on his stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask us if you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Understood!
I'll join you once I've figured out this character!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Commonalities.... What do we have in common...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're really the exact opposites of each other... It's like my grasp of this character keeps slipping away the more I read this script...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The smallest things bother him so much, but he knows he isn't able to play his best. And yet, he keeps looking up at the stars...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If I were in his shoes, I'd buck up and take this issue by the horns!! Like I'm doing now!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, hold on!
Complaining won't get me anywhere! First, I need to discover what we have in common!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start again from the top!
That also goes for the original novella!
A few days later
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Do we actually have anything in common...? Thinking hasn't gotten me anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, we must have something in common... If Rui believes so, then the answer has to be out there somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But a hint would be nice.
An objective opinion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I know...!
I'll just...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, there you all are...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Tsukasa!
Tsukasaaa!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, Tsukasa, good evening.
We never see you here this late.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry for the intrusion.
But there's something I need to ask all of you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ask us?
Oh, is this about playing Thorpe?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes.
Rui must've already spoken with you about it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm having so much trouble figuring out what he and I have in common. I hate to ask this, but can any of you give me some sort of hint?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And Rui told me that you'll be replacing me for the time being. So, how was it? What was it like being him...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm happy to help.
But I'm not the one playing Thorpe. You'll have to ask Miku here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! That's me♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Miku, you're playing Thorpe?!
But you're 180-degrees... No, 360-degrees the opposite of him!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean you're right back where you started...? Regardless, yes, Miku said she wanted to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why take on this role, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you're trying so hard, Tsukasa! You made me want to try just as hard!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
In that case, I'd like to hear what you have to say! How did you take on the role of Thorpe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, so I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“Gwah!
I only have half a day left!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “The stars! They're so beautiful!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hold on...
That doesn't sound like him at all!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, Thorpe's such a tough nut to crack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel like there's a deeper issue at hand here... I mean, this scene's about how he's trying to overcome this failing of his before the contest, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's supposed to be in a state of total despair.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?!
But I'd feel so much better by seeing those stars!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not what I'm... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Feel better? After seeing those stars...? Wait, I feel like I've heard that before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa? Is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Uh, no...
I thought I managed to figure something out just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! You did?!
Tell us! Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh! Hold your horses!
I'm trying to remember...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You can do it, Tsukasa.
bgm_area00004
One week later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hey, Mr. Pianist!
Can you play a song for us?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “We want to learn how to dance to a song for this party we'll be attending soon.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“I don't care about your party!
I'm busy! Leave me alone!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, these scene seems fine...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But... Is Tsukasa gonna be okay...?
He's been at it for pretty long now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He'll be fine! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa's our super twinkly star!
I know he's gonna find a way!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Thank you for that, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Miku! Hi, KAITO!
Good wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello there.
I take it Tsukasa won't be practicing with us here yet...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
We're yet to receive word from him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, it seemed like he had a bit of a realization the last time he was here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? He was here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! He was trying really hard and nodding his head a lot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
That's our star for you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sure he'll get through this.
So let's place our faith in him and keep waiting since I believe that's all we can do for him right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Okay!
